env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos eject -o out
grep 'Logos_GetName' out/main.go
! grep -E 'Logos_GetStart|Logos_SetStart' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constmix

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type RO interface {
	const Name string
	const Start() error
}

type Gadget struct : RO {
	Name string
}

func (m Gadget) Start() error {
	return nil
}

func use(c RO) string {
	return c.Name
}

func main() {
	m := Gadget{Name: "g"}
	var r RO = m
	fmt.Println(use(m))
	fmt.Println(r.Name)
	fmt.Println(r.Start() == nil)
}
